text:
anna: Posting Spectra postmortem follow-ups. Root cause summary: customer edge was stripping VLAN tags and our VXLAN/MTU assumptions caused large frame drops; this led to repeated connection resets and a cascading eviction pattern in the Dedicated pool that looked like tenant isolation. I distilled the follow-ups below.

pablo: Thanks. Can we get a short owner/timeline list so we can slot into the sprint?

anna: Short workstreams: infra peering + MTU hardening, runtime defensive recon/drain, DevEx harness for VLAN/VXLAN stripping, telemetry/alerts, customer coordination, and a recurrence-scan.

rachel: I'll own infra (SPEC-7001). Plan: add MTU-aware routes, enable fragmentation-safe probes for peered prefixes, and add a conservative drop rule for unexpected fragmented flows. PR target Wed EOD; canary Fri 01:00-02:30 UTC on 5% prefixes. Will require a 90-min window and rollback plan.

infra-bot: ticket SPEC-7001 created by rachel.

devex: I'll build a harness (SPEC-7002) to reproduce VLAN tag stripping + VXLAN MTU mismatch and to validate the runtime behavior. Will add the regression to nightly; demo Thu.

pablo: Runtime owner? We need a defensive path so we don't hard-evict on fragment/mtu failures. Also metrics to make the canary observable.

anna: Assigning runtime to pablo (SPEC-7003). Tasks: on detection of repeated fragment drops mark connections suspect, perform a staggered soft-drain, run an active MTU probe sequence, and avoid mass hard-eviction. Prototype this week.

pablo: Proposed runtime checklist (to attach to ticket):
- detect sustained fragment/icmp-need-frag events for 20s -> mark peer as MTU-uncertain
- run active MTU probes [1500,1400,1280] with 1s timeout
- when MTU change detected, switch to safe frame-size and stagger recon with per-tenant jitter
- emit metrics: mtu_probe.count, mtu_probe.fail_rate, conn.suspect_count, conn.soft_evictions

pablo: pseudo-hook for graceful handling:
```
def on_fragment_signals(peer):
  mark_peer_mtu_uncertain(peer, ttl=300)
  for c in active_conns.to_peer(peer):
    c.mark_suspect()
    schedule(c.soft_drain, delay=rand(4,12))
```

rachel: Infra snippet for PR (gated during canary):
```bash
# enable fragmentation-safe probe and prefer established
iptables -A INPUT -s <peer-cidr> -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
# allow fragments for peered ranges during canary, then enforce
iptables -A INPUT -f -s <peer-cidr> -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -s <peer-cidr> -j DROP
```

rachel: We'll only enable the final DROP after 30m stable metrics and with an allowlist.

devex: Harness tests: (1) VLAN tag stripped on ingress -> assert no tenant-wide hard-eviction under soft-drain; (2) VXLAN MTU blackhole -> assert reconverge within 30s and eviction rate <= 1e-4. Will push failing tests first to show regression.

anna: Customer comms (SPEC-7004): I'll draft a short postmortem and recommend they validate VLAN passthrough and VXLAN MTU on their edge load balancers. I'll ask for a maintenance slot for their network team to test and propose Tue 22:00 UTC.

pablo: Success criteria to add to tickets: 1) synthetic VLAN-strip replay shows zero tenant isolation for 10m; 2) eviction rate <= 0.0001 during canary; 3) MTU probe latency < 250ms and reconvergence within 30s; 4) customer confirms VLAN/VXLAN validation within 3 business days.

infra-bot: Created SPEC-7002 (harness), SPEC-7003 (runtime), SPEC-7004 (comms) linked to SPEC-7001.

anna: Telemetry/alerts: add saved dashboard and alert: eviction_rate > 0.0002 over 15m, mtu_probe.fail_rate > 0.1 over 10m. Include a Kibana saved query in PRs for quick checks:

kql: message:eviction AND tenant:spectra AND timestamp:[now-30m TO now]

pablo: I'll add the logging hooks and metric names to SPEC-7003. Also add a logs query to the runtime PR template to export pre/post eviction counts per-tenant for the canary window.

rachel: Timeline recap:
- SPEC-7002 (harness) -> devex demo Thu
- SPEC-7003 (runtime) -> prototype Thu, PR Mon
- SPEC-7001 (infra) -> PR Wed EOD, canary Fri 01:00-02:30 UTC
- SPEC-7004 (comms) -> anna to send Tue EOD

sre-oncall: I'll monitor the canary and stand by for rollback. Please include a rollback play: revert DROP lines and toggle mtu-probe off.

anna: Also proposing a monthly recurrence scan SPEC-7005 that searches past incidents for VLAN/VXLAN/MTU indicators and surfaces customers with repeated symptoms. I'll own the initial run and add it to the ops calendar.

pablo: Good call. Add success criteria and dashboard links to each PR. If anyone needs to reassign owners or change windows, reply in-thread. I'll join the Thu handoff sync. :thumbsup:
